prior_claim: The three notions of regularity are said to agree in the Noetherian case.
correction: For sequences require a Noetherian local ring, a finite nonzero module, and elements of the maximal ideal (or the appropriate Jacobson-radical version). Noetherianity alone does not suffice; a product-ring counterexample is given.

prior_claim: The Hilbert-series upper bound and converse from equality are stated without the surjectivity hypothesis.
correction: Require surjectivity of v, equivalently the kernel condition together with composite augmentation. Splitting alone does not imply the inequality, and equal Hilbert series alone does not imply v is an isomorphism; finite counterexamples are certified.

prior_claim: The earlier check declares both the kernel criterion and Hilbert-series assertion correct given composite augmentation.
correction: Composite augmentation repairs the kernel equivalence. The Hilbert assertion additionally needs surjectivity of v; the three finite G4 counterexamples distinguish the missing hypotheses.

prior_claim: u:C to B is called an inverse a gauche of the surjection phi:B to C.
correction: The intended section identity is phi composed with u equals id_C, so u is a right inverse of phi. A left inverse would instead satisfy u composed with phi equals id_B; combined with the stated surjectivity that would force phi to be an isomorphism. The original handwriting confirms the gauche wording.

prior_claim: The first open implication is A flat over K implies C flat over B.
correction: This direction is false even under the very good conditions. The exact replacement is C flat over B iff A=K; the other two implications are true, with the equivalences in G1.
